items.reason: Inclusion says "recurrent or progressive malignant primary brain tumor (WHO grade III or IV), including recurrent ependymoma". Glioblastoma and glioma are never named in conditions, title, inclusion or arm label; "high-grade glioma" appears only in the summary, which C7 does not allow. D27C and D30-R7 cover grade 4 glioma or astrocytoma, not a grade IV brain tumour of any histology. The eligible fields do not say high-grade or malignant glioma, so the residual category not_glioblastoma fits better than high_grade_glioma_unspecified. Both exclude.
Glioblastoma would be eligible in practice, but it is not named in any eligible field, and the grade range concerns brain tumours in general rather than glioma, so D30-R7 does not apply as written.

note: This is a screening decision (S5) at the edge of D30-R7: 'malignant primary brain tumor (WHO grade III or IV)' allows grade IV without naming glioma or glioblastoma. Excluded under the rulings as written; XL should decide whether R7 extends to grade III-IV brain tumour wording. Mixed-age trial (children's and adults' strata). CSF PK is planned, so tumour_pk_planned is yes.
